e.title: MIB（英国汽车保险人局）：无保险与肇事逃逸索赔、车辆保险状态公开查验
e.title_en: MIB (UK Motor Insurers’ Bureau): claims against uninsured and hit-and-run drivers, plus a public vehicle insurance status check
e.title_hk: MIB（英國汽車保險人局）：無保險與肇事逃逸索賠、車輛保險狀態公開查驗
e.summary: 英国汽车保险业出资的非营利机构（1946 年成立）：处理无保险与肇事逃逸驾驶人的索赔，运营免费公开的车辆保险状态在线查验，并向警方与数据接收方提供数据，另设外国车辆索赔路径
e.summary_en: A UK not-for-profit funded by the motor insurance industry (established 1946): it handles claims against uninsured and hit-and-run drivers, runs a free public online vehicle insurance status check, supplies data to police and other data recipients, and provides a claim route for people hit by a foreign vehicle
e.summary_hk: 英國汽車保險業出資的非營利機構（1946 年成立）：處理無保險與肇事逃逸駕駛人的索賠，運營免費公開的車輛保險狀態線上查驗，並向警方與數據接收方提供數據，另設外國車輛索賠路徑
e.body:
**MIB（Motor Insurers’ Bureau，英国汽车保险人局）** 是**英国汽车保险业出资设立的非营利机构**（站点正文实测自述：**「MIB is a not-for-profit organisation making roads safer by tackling uninsured and hit-and-run driving. We’ve been here since 1946」**）。本条目补的是**「行业级理赔与数据基础设施」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**；**它与同轮三条（[[cila]] 资格、[[fuedi]] 欧洲伞状、[[clm]] 跨行业专业组织）的区别在于：MIB 不是专业团体，而是一个**由全行业出资、承担法定/行业性补偿与全国数据职能的机构**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **72.2KB，标题实测「Make a claim or check and learn about insurance | Making roads safer | MIB」**；⭐ **「About MIB」页 `/about-mib/` 实测 50.9KB，标题实测「Our purpose and how we’re funded（我们的宗旨与资金来源）」**，正文逐字含上述 1946 年与非营利自述；⭐ **「Check your vehicle（查验你的车辆）」页 `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` 实测 52.5KB，标题实测「Check your vehicle insurance status online」**，正文逐字含 **「Check your motor insurance status instantly using our free Check Your Vehicle online tool」**；⭐ **「Our members（我们的成员）」页 `/about-mib/our-members/` 实测 52.4KB**；⭐ **「Data resources for data recipients（面向数据接收方的数据资源）」页 `/for-professionals/data-recipients/` 实测 42.2KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Check and stay insured** 含 **Am I insured?（我投保了吗？）**、⭐ **Check your vehicle**、**I’ve received a letter（我收到了一封信）**；**Make a claim** 含 **Can I claim with MIB?**、**How the claims process works**、**Manage an existing claim**、⭐ **I’ve been hit by a foreign vehicle（我被外国车辆撞了）**、**Support and reassurance**；**Learn about insurance** 含 **Common insurance myths**、**New and young drivers**、**Parents of young drivers**、**What to do after an accident**、**Driving abroad**、**Avoiding insurance scams**、**The future of driving**、⭐ **Motor terrorism（汽车恐怖主义）**；**Professionals** 含 **Insurers and brokers**、**Solicitors and claims handlers**、⭐ **Data recipients**、⭐ **Police（警方）**；**About MIB** 含 **Business plan 2026**、**Governance and compliance**、**Our members**、**Our strategy**、**Your data and privacy**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「无保险驾驶」这一风险池的行业补偿机制**——**无保险驾驶与肇事逃逸是车险中无法向对方追偿的情形**，**MIB 的存在说明这类风险由全行业出资兜底**；**这与池内 [[fscs-uk]]（金融机构倒闭）、[[nolhga]]（保险公司破产）、[[assuris]]（保单持有人保障）属同一「兜底机制」家族，但触发原因完全不同（不是机构倒闭，而是**肇事方无保险**）**——**对本轮而言，它把兜底机制的谱系又扩出一格**（**可与 [[pbgc]]、[[seadrif]] 并读**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「车辆保险状态公开查验」是本条最有实用价值的机制**——**任何人均可免费在线查验一辆车的保险状态**；**这背后必然是全国性的保险数据库**（**即从保险公司汇集投保数据、供公众与警方查询**）；**对做保险数据基础设施的学生，这是一个「以公共目的汇集行业数据」的成熟样本**——**可与池内 [[susep-sro]]（监管强制逐笔登记）、[[susep-open-insurance]]（同意制跨公司共享）并读，形成「强制登记 / 同意共享 / 公共查验」三种数据汇集目的对照**（**注意：本次未运行任何查询，也未核实数据库的名称、规模与开放范围**）。**③ 明确区分「Insurers and brokers / Solicitors and claims handlers / Data recipients / Police」四类专业用户**——**同一机构按「谁需要什么数据」组织面向专业人士的入口**；**其中**警方**出现在数据用户名单里，说明该数据库也服务于执法**。**④ ⭐ 「Motor terrorism（汽车恐怖主义）」是罕见栏目**——**把车辆作为恐袭工具所致的第三方损害单列**（**本次未打开内容，故不转述其处理方式**）。**⑤ 「Business plan 2026」与「Governance and compliance」公开**——**该机构披露年度业务计划与治理合规**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、两处关键正文自述（1946 年、非营利、免费查验工具）、以及导航逐字实测的完整栏目结构**，**但未打开业务计划、治理与合规页、成员页内容、任何数据接收方资源、未运行车辆查验工具、未核实数据库的名称与规模**，因此**不能转述任何索赔金额、案件数量、成员名单、数据库字段或查询结果**；**② ⭐ 「运营全国车辆保险数据库」是我依据「免费在线查验车辆保险状态」这一实测事实所作的**合理推断**，**本次未打开任何页面证明该数据库的名称、运营方或数据范围**——**词条内已将其表述为「背后必然是全国性的保险数据库」并在此标注为推断**；**③ 「由全行业出资」依据页标题「Our purpose and **how we’re funded**」与「Our members / Insurers and brokers」等栏目**，**本次未打开核实具体出资机制**；**④ 「1946 年成立」为页面正文逐字实测**，**但该机构与英国法定强制车险制度的关系（如是否具有法定职能）本次未核实**；**⑤ 「Motor terrorism」栏目内容未核实**；**⑥ 该机构与同轮 [[fscs-uk]] 的职能边界本次未核实**——**词条内未作两者关系主张**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** MIB 提供精算工具、定价数据或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（72.2KB）、`/about-mib/`（50.9KB）、`/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/`（52.5KB）、`/about-mib/our-members/`（52.4KB）、`/for-professionals/data-recipients/`（42.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、正文自述与导航；**未打开业务计划、治理页、成员内容、数据接收方资源，亦未运行查验工具**。
e.body_en:
**MIB (the Motor Insurers’ Bureau)** is **a UK not-for-profit funded by the motor insurance industry** (measured verbatim from its own page: **"MIB is a not-for-profit organisation making roads safer by tackling uninsured and hit-and-run driving. We’ve been here since 1946"**). This entry adds the **"industry-level claims and data infrastructure"** form — **measured zero**; **unlike the round’s other three ([[cila]] qualifications, [[fuedi]] a European umbrella, [[clm]] a cross-industry professional body), MIB is not a professional association but an institution funded by the whole industry that carries out statutory or industry-wide compensation and national data functions**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **72.2KB with the measured title "Make a claim or check and learn about insurance | Making roads safer | MIB"**; ⭐ the **"About MIB" page `/about-mib/` measures 50.9KB with the measured title "Our purpose and how we’re funded"**, its body carrying the 1946 and not-for-profit statement quoted above; ⭐ the **"Check your vehicle" page `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` measures 52.5KB with the measured title "Check your vehicle insurance status online"**, its body stating verbatim **"Check your motor insurance status instantly using our free Check Your Vehicle online tool"**; ⭐ the **"Our members" page measures 52.4KB**; ⭐ the **"Data resources for data recipients" page measures 42.2KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the structure**: **Check and stay insured** covers **Am I insured?**, ⭐ **Check your vehicle** and **I’ve received a letter**; **Make a claim** covers **Can I claim with MIB?**, **How the claims process works**, **Manage an existing claim**, ⭐ **I’ve been hit by a foreign vehicle** and **Support and reassurance**; **Learn about insurance** covers **Common insurance myths**, **New and young drivers**, **Parents of young drivers**, **What to do after an accident**, **Driving abroad**, **Avoiding insurance scams**, **The future of driving** and ⭐ **Motor terrorism**; **Professionals** covers **Insurers and brokers**, **Solicitors and claims handlers**, ⭐ **Data recipients** and ⭐ **Police**; **About MIB** covers **Business plan 2026**, **Governance and compliance**, **Our members**, **Our strategy** and **Your data and privacy**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the industry compensation mechanism for the uninsured-driving risk pool** — **uninsured driving and hit-and-run are the cases in motor insurance where there is no counterparty to recover from**, **and MIB’s existence means the whole industry funds a backstop for them**; **this belongs to the same "backstop mechanism" family as [[fscs-uk]] (failed financial firms), [[nolhga]] (insolvent insurers) and [[assuris]] (policyholder protection), but the triggering cause is entirely different (not an institutional failure, but a tortfeasor with no insurance)** — **it extends the family tree of backstop mechanisms by one branch** (readable with [[pbgc]] and [[seadrif]]). **② ⭐⭐ The public vehicle insurance status check is the most practically valuable mechanism here** — **anyone can check a vehicle’s insurance status online for free**; **this necessarily rests on a national insurance database** (**policy data collected from insurers and made queryable by the public and the police**); **for work on insurance data infrastructure this is a mature sample of aggregating industry data for a public purpose** — **readable with [[susep-sro]] (mandatory operation-level reporting) and [[susep-open-insurance]] (consented cross-firm sharing) to give three purposes of data aggregation: mandatory registry, consented sharing, and public verification** (**note: no query was run, and the database’s name, size and scope were not verified**). **③ It explicitly separates four professional audiences — Insurers and brokers, Solicitors and claims handlers, Data recipients and Police** — **one body organising professional entry points by who needs which data**; **that the police appear among data users indicates the database also serves law enforcement**. **④ ⭐ "Motor terrorism" is a rare section** — **third-party damage caused by using a vehicle as a terror instrument is treated separately** (**its content was not opened, so its treatment is not restated**). **⑤ The 2026 business plan and the governance and compliance page are public** (**neither was opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, two key verbatim self-descriptions (1946, not-for-profit, a free check tool), and the complete section structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no business plan, governance page, member content or data-recipient resource, ran no vehicle check, and did not establish the database’s name or size**, so **no claim amount, case count, member list, database field or query result can be restated**; **② ⭐ "operates a national vehicle insurance database" is a reasonable inference from the measured fact that vehicle insurance status can be checked online for free**, **and no page proving the database’s name, operator or data scope was opened** — **the entry phrases it as "this necessarily rests on a national insurance database" and the inference is flagged here**; **③ "funded by the whole industry" rests on the page title "Our purpose and how we’re funded" and sections such as Our members and Insurers and brokers**, **with the funding mechanism itself not opened**; **④ "established 1946" is read verbatim from the page body**, **but the body’s relationship with the UK’s compulsory motor insurance regime (for example whether its functions are statutory) was not verified**; **⑤ the content of the Motor terrorism section was not verified**; **⑥ the boundary between MIB and [[fscs-uk]] was not verified, and the entry makes no claim about their relationship**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim MIB provides actuarial tools, pricing data or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: the homepage (72.2KB), `/about-mib/` (50.9KB), `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` (52.5KB), `/about-mib/our-members/` (52.4KB) and `/for-professionals/data-recipients/` (42.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, body statements and navigation read verbatim; **no business plan, governance page, member content or data-recipient resource was opened and no check tool was run**.
e.body_hk:
**MIB（Motor Insurers’ Bureau，英國汽車保險人局）** 是**英國汽車保險業出資設立的非營利機構**（站點正文實測自述：**「MIB is a not-for-profit organisation making roads safer by tackling uninsured and hit-and-run driving. We’ve been here since 1946」**）。本條目補的是**「行業級理賠與數據基礎設施」這一形態**——**實測為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **72.2KB**；⭐ **`/about-mib/` 50.9KB，標題實測「Our purpose and how we’re funded」**，正文含上述 1946 年與非營利自述；⭐ **`/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` 52.5KB，標題實測「Check your vehicle insurance status online」**，正文逐字含 **「Check your motor insurance status instantly using our free Check Your Vehicle online tool」**；⭐ **`/about-mib/our-members/` 52.4KB**；⭐ **`/for-professionals/data-recipients/` 42.2KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**Make a claim** 含 Can I claim with MIB?／How the claims process works／Manage an existing claim／⭐**I’ve been hit by a foreign vehicle**；**Learn about insurance** 含 Common insurance myths／Driving abroad／Avoiding insurance scams／⭐**Motor terrorism（汽車恐怖主義）**；**Professionals** 含 Insurers and brokers／Solicitors and claims handlers／⭐**Data recipients**／⭐**Police（警方）**；**About MIB** 含 **Business plan 2026**／**Governance and compliance**／**Our members**／**Our strategy**／**Your data and privacy**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「無保險駕駛」這一風險池的行業補償機制**——**與 [[fscs-uk]]、[[nolhga]]、[[assuris]] 同屬「兜底機制」家族，但觸發原因完全不同（不是機構倒閉，而是肇事方無保險）**，**把兜底機制譜系再擴一格**（可與 [[pbgc]]、[[seadrif]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐ 「車輛保險狀態公開查驗」是本條最有實用價值的機制**——**任何人均可免費線上查驗一輛車的保險狀態**；**這背後必然是全**國性保險數據庫**；**對做保險數據基礎設施的學生，這是「以公共目的匯集行業數據」的成熟樣本**——**與 [[susep-sro]]（監管強制逐筆登記）、[[susep-open-insurance]]（同意制跨公司共享）並讀，形成「強制登記／同意共享／公共查驗」三種數據匯集目的對照**（**注意：本次未運行任何查詢**）。**③ 明確區分四類專業用戶**（保險公司與經紀／律師與理賠處理人／數據接收方／**警方**）——**警方出現在數據用戶名單，說明該數據庫也服務執法**。**④ ⭐ 「Motor terrorism」是罕見欄目**（**本次未打開內容**）。**⑤ 「Business plan 2026」與「Governance and compliance」公開**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、兩處關鍵正文自述、導航逐字實測的完整欄目結構**，**但未打開業務計劃、治理頁、成員頁內容、任何數據接收方資源、未運行查驗工具、未核實數據庫名稱與規模**，故**不能轉述任何索賠金額、案件數量、成員名單、數據庫欄位或查詢結果**；**② ⭐ 「運營全國車輛保險數據庫」是我依據「免費線上查驗車輛保險狀態」這一實測事實所作的合理推斷**，**詞條內已表述為「背後必然是全國性的保險數據庫」並在此標注為推斷**；**③ 「由全行業出資」依據頁標題「Our purpose and how we’re funded」與 Our members 等欄目**，**未打開核實具體出資機制**；**④ 「1946 年成立」為正文逐字實測**，**但其與英國法定強制車險制度的关系未核實**；**⑤ 「Motor terrorism」欄目內容未核實**；**⑥ 與同輪 [[fscs-uk]] 的職能邊界未核實，詞條內未作兩者關係主張**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** MIB 提供精算工具、定價數據或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題、正文自述與導航；**未打開業務計劃、治理頁、成員內容、數據接收方資源，亦未運行查驗工具**。
